taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Firebase custom-token minting and caller-to-UID/claims binding
controls.source_trace: Trace how an authenticated application caller can select Firebase uid or privileged claims. Validate upstream identity before the trusted minting operation.
controls.implementation_branch: The issuer must derive UID and privileged claims from an authorized identity mapping, not accept them as caller assertions. Custom tokens are exchanged for Firebase ID tokens; do not confuse their audiences and validation roles. A server/Admin SDK bypassing client rules is expected unless an untrusted caller can exercise that server authority.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an emulator/local issuer fixture with two synthetic identities; compare rightful token identity and a caller-selected foreign uid/role.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Public Firebase configuration is not minting authority; an unused custom claim is not a demonstrated privilege grant.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind minting to verified identity and permitted claims, then test final rules/consumer authority and legitimate sign-in.
